HOUSTON


, Oct. 26, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Flotek Industries, Inc. ("Flotek" or the "Company") (NYSE: FTK) today announced that the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency ("EPA") has approved its proprietary VeraCAL optical system as an alternative to gas chromatography for measuring flare vent gas composition and net heating value ("NHV") under 40 CFR Part 63, Subpart CC, National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants From Petroleum Refineries ("MACT CC").


The Company believes the approval positions its Data Analytics business to serve petroleum refinery compliance monitoring, a significant new opportunity for VeraCAL. It marks VeraCAL's second EPA alternative-method approval, building on its initial approval in July 2024. The EPA has published the new approval as Alternative Test Method 163 (ALT-163), available at:[https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2026-10/alt_163_signed.pdf](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806754-1&h=3472154437&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epa.gov%2Fsystem%2Ffiles%2Fdocuments%2F2026-10%2Falt_163_signed.pdf&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epa.gov%2Fsystem%2Ffiles%2Fdocuments%2F2026-10%2Falt_163_signed.pdf) .


"This approval is an important step in expanding our Data Analytics business," said Dr. Ryan Ezell, Chief Executive Officer of Flotek. "Refiners need dependable measurement technology that supports both compliance and day-to-day operations. We believe VeraCAL's continuous, near real-time measurements can provide actionable information while simplifying the demands of flare monitoring."


MACT CC's flare requirements create an ongoing need for reliable gas-quality measurements. Refinery operators also seek monitoring solutions that are easier to maintain and less costly to operate. VeraCAL is designed for challenging industrial environments to address both needs through continuous optical measurement without carrier gas or chromatographic separation. The U.S. refining industry included 130 operable refineries as of January 1, 2026. Recent EPA rulemakings have also extended refinery-style flare monitoring requirements to certain chemical manufacturing and gasoline distribution operations.


Flotek's Data Analytics segment is driving innovation in flare compliance measurement through its VeraCAL technology and monitoring services. Building on VeraCAL's measurement technology and data, the Company believes the new EPA approval strengthens its position in compliance measurement and creates opportunities to serve refinery customers, broaden its customer base and grow through near real-time data solutions.


**About Flotek Industries, Inc.**


Flotek Industries, Inc. is a global technology-driven company that combines the synergy of proprietary technologies through near real-time data analytics and advanced chemistry to collaboratively address complex challenges for energy, industrial and infrastructure sector customers and help them optimize operations, enhance asset performance and maximize financial returns.


Leveraging a portfolio of more than 130 patents, over two decades of field and laboratory data, and a global presence in more than 59 countries, Flotek delivers innovative, data-driven solutions designed to create measurable value across the energy and infrastructure lifecycle.


Flotek is based in Houston, Texas and its common shares are traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "FTK."
